DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご覧になりたい動物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any animals you'd like to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この「食事の時間」は、お客さんも餌をあげられるという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給餌見学と参加体験の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does this feeding time mean visitors can feed them too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between watching feeding and participating in it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内は飼育員による給餌の見学です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This notice is for watching the keepers feed them.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。私が持っている食べ物を渡してはいけないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参食品を与えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. So I mustn't give them the food I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not give the animals your own food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。動物には与えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Please don't give it to the animals.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもにも説明します。食べ物は袋にしまってから見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもへの説明と食品収納を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll explain to my child too. We'll put the food away in a bag before watching.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will explain to your child and put the food away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見学場所はこちらです。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 遠くからでも見えますか。子どもを柵に登らせたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 柵に登らず見える位置を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Can we see from farther away too? I don't want my child to climb the fence.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Look for a viewing position that does not involve climbing the fence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見えにくければ、空いている位置からご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If it's hard to see, please watch from an unoccupied position.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、混む前に場所を見ます。見えなくても柵には登らず待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 視界不良でも安全な位置で待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll check the area before it gets crowded. Even if we can't see, we'll wait without climbing the fence.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait in a safe position even if the view is poor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 柵の外側からご見学ください。食事の様子を静かにお楽しみいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch from outside the fence. You can quietly enjoy seeing them eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この花束になさいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: きれいですが、相手が強い香りを苦手としているのを思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈答相手の香りへの苦手意識を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's beautiful, but I remembered that the recipient dislikes strong scents.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the gift recipient's dislike of strong scents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 香りも含めて選び直しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like to choose again, taking scent into account too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。見た目だけで決めず、香りが控えめな候補を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 香りを含む選び直しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Rather than choosing only by appearance, I'd like to see lightly scented options.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to choose again with scent in mind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらを近くでお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check this one up close.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私はほとんど感じませんが、相手も平気とは限りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の感覚と相手の感覚を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can hardly smell it, but that doesn't necessarily mean the recipient will be fine with it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your own sense of smell from the recipient's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 感じ方には個人差があります。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、小さい花束にして、部屋へ置くかは相手に任せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小花束と相手判断の置き場所を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll choose a small bouquet and leave it to the recipient whether to put it in their room.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a small bouquet and leave the placement decision to the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 包装はいかがしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: How would you like it wrapped?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 香りを閉じ込めるために包むのではなく、持ち運び用の普通の包装でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 包装目的を持運びと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please use normal wrapping for carrying it, rather than wrapping it to trap the scent inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify carrying as the purpose of the wrapping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。小さな花束に整えて、持ち運び用に包みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll arrange a small bouquet and wrap it for carrying.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列から離れられますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが疲れました。夫だけ残して、二人分の順番を取ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者残留での順番確保を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is tired. Can I leave just my husband here to hold places for the two of us?
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about securing places by leaving a companion in the line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中合流の扱いを係員に確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need to check with the attendant how rejoining partway is handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、勝手に戻らず、夫も含めてどうするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無断途中合流を避け家族で判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then we won't just return without permission. I'll decide what to do together with my husband too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid unauthorized rejoining and decide as a family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 体験を急がなくてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is it okay not to rush into the activity?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。子どもを休ませる方を優先します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 体験より子どもの休憩を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll prioritize letting my child rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize your child's rest over the activity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 全員で列を離れるご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like everyone to leave the line?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。次の方へ進んでもらって、休憩します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族全員で離列すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll do that. We'll let the next people move forward and take a break.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the whole family will leave the line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再利用の場合は入口でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you want to participate again, please check at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。休んでから、子どもが参加したいか改めて聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩後に子どもの意向を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. After resting, I'll ask my child again whether they want to participate.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your child's wishes after the break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 全員で列の外へどうぞ。再び参加する際は、入口からご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please all step outside the line. If you participate again, ask at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何個お入れしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many shall I put in?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三個ですが、渡す日が違います。全部同じ熟し具合だと困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配る日が異なる三個の熟度を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Three, but I'll give them out on different days. It would be a problem if they were all equally ripe.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss ripeness for three items to be given on different days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初はいつお渡しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: When will you give the first one?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つは今日、二つは週末です。食べる日も相手に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日分と週末分を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One today and two at the weekend. I'd also like to tell the recipients when to eat them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which are for today and which are for the weekend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を見て候補を分けますが、変化には幅があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll separate options by looking at their condition, but the pace of change varies.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必ず週末に食べ頃とは約束せず、家で様子を見るよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 熟期の保証を避け状態確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't promise they'll definitely be ready to eat at the weekend. I'll tell them to check the condition at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid guaranteeing ripening time and say the condition should be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like separate bags too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今日の一つと、週末の二つを分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配布日別の袋分けを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please separate the one for today from the two for the weekend.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request separate bags by the day you will give them out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 目印を付けておきます。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。受け取る時に、どちらが今日用かもう一度確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取時に今日用を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. When I collect them, I'll check again which one is for today.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match the item for today again at collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが今日用です。残りは状態を見ながら、お渡しの日を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This one is for today. Decide when to give the rest by checking their condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお皿を下げてよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し待ってください。皿の横に指輪を置いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 皿下げを止め指輪の存在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please wait a moment. I had put my ring beside the plate.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Stop the plate being cleared and mention the ring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様の指輪はこちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。食べる時に外しました。紙ナプキンで包んだので、見えにくくなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外した経緯とナプキン包みを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I took it off to eat. I wrapped it in a paper napkin, so it's hard to see.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain taking it off and wrapping it in a napkin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 片づける前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check before we clear up.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分で包みを開けて、指輪を取り出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が包みを開け回収すると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll open the wrapping myself and take the ring out.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to open the wrapping and retrieve the ring yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今度は机へ戻さず、鞄の小さいポケットへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 机でなく鞄ポケットへ収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. This time, instead of putting it back on the table, I'll put it in my bag's small pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Store it in a bag pocket instead of on the table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、ナプキンとお皿を片づけてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then may I clear the napkin and plate?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。指輪はしまいました。空のナプキンと皿をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指輪回収後に片付けを許可する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've put the ring away. Please take the empty napkin and plate.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Allow clearing after retrieving the ring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お片づけします。お帰りの際も、鞄とお持ち物をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll clear them. Please check your bag and belongings when you leave too.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この低い所は座ってよい場所ですか。椅子に見えたのですが。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物部材への着席可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this low part somewhere we can sit? It looked like a chair.
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may sit on a building component. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物の一部ですので、腰掛けないでください。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's part of the building, so please don't sit on it.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。触る前に聞いてよかったです。休める所は別にありますか。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休憩場所の代替を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I'm glad I asked before touching it. Is there somewhere else to rest?
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for an alternative resting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見学室の外に休憩席があります。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are rest seats outside the viewing room.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、建物の中では立って見て、外で休みます。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 屋内見学と屋外休憩を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll stand while viewing inside the building and rest outside.
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate indoor viewing from resting outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 足元にも段差があります。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are changes in floor level underfoot too.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。友人にも、横木は座る所ではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者へ部材保護の注意を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll also tell my friend the horizontal beam isn't a seat.
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your companion the precaution for protecting the building components. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明をご覧になる場合は壁側へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you'd like to read the explanation, please go toward the wall.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。段差をまたぐ前に足元を見て、案内板へ進みます。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 足元を見ながら解説へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll look where I'm stepping before crossing the change in level and go to the information board.
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed to the explanation while watching your step. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 外の休憩席もご利用ください。建物の一部には座らずご見学をお願いします。
DLG-SC-TYM-NANTO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the rest seats outside too. View the building without sitting on its components.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業を止めた理由を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me why you stopped working.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもと違う音がしました。速度を変えて続けず、安全手順に従って停止しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 異音と安全停止を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard an unusual sound. Rather than changing the speed and continuing, I stopped following the safety procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the unusual sound and safe stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音がしたのはどの段階ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: At which stage did the sound occur?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 材料を送っている途中です。中の原因は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音発生段階と未確認原因を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: While feeding the material through. I haven't checked the cause inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the stage when the sound occurred from the unconfirmed cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内部に手を入れず、責任者へ確認を求めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't put your hands inside; ask the supervisor to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。音が出た時の材料も、ほかと分けて残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象材料を分離保存する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll also keep the material from when the sound occurred separate from the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the relevant material stored separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いつから音が変わりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この一枚を始めた時です。前の一枚では気づきませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発生開始を前材料と比較して述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I started this sheet. I didn't notice it with the previous sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the start of the sound by comparison with the previous material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録にその経緯を残しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's leave a record of that sequence.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。原因を「刃の故障」と決めず、聞いた音と時点だけ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原因断定を避け観察を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't decide the cause was a faulty blade; I'll write only the sound I heard and when.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record observations without declaring the cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 責任者に引き継ぎます。再開の指示が出るまで、機械には触れず待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass it on to the supervisor. Please wait without touching the machine until instructions to restart are given.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お布団を敷く時間のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss when to lay out the futons?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。部屋に荷物を広げてしまいました。先に片づけた方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 布団敷き前の荷物整理を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've spread my luggage around the room. I should tidy it first, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss organizing luggage before futon preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの場所を空けていただけますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。鞄を隅へ寄せます。貴重品は自分で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定場所を空け貴重品を携帯する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll move my bag to the corner and keep my valuables with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clear the designated space and carry your valuables. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 夕食の間に準備するご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like us to prepare them during dinner?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。ただ、衣類を動かしてもらうのではなく、自分でまとめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夕食中の準備と自分での衣類整理を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. However, rather than having you move my clothes, I'll gather them together myself beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request preparation during dinner and say you will organize your clothes yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部屋への入室は差し支えありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is it all right for us to enter the room?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 準備のためなら大丈夫です。食事へ行く前に、戸の閉め方も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 準備入室を了承し戸の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's fine for the preparation. Before going to dinner, I'd also like to check how to close the door.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to entry for preparation and ask about the door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出る際は施錠をお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。片づけて施錠してから、食事へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 整理施錠後に食事へ出ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll tidy and lock up before going to dinner.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave for dinner after tidying and locking the door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その後に準備いたします。指定の場所を空けてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll prepare afterward. Please clear the designated area before you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 接種される方はお二人ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ、接種するのは私だけです。夫は付き添いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 接種本人と付添人を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: No, only I am. My husband is accompanying me.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the vaccination recipient from the accompanying person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票も一名分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the appointment slip also for one person?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。一枚です。夫の名前は緊急連絡先の欄にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一名予約と連絡先欄を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, one slip. My husband's name is in the emergency-contact field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the one-person booking and contact field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 接種者の欄とは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's separate from the vaccination recipient field.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうです。夫の名前を消さず、連絡先として残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夫名を連絡先として残すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. Please leave my husband's name as a contact instead of deleting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for your husband's name to remain as a contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 問診票はご本人が記入できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you fill in the questionnaire yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書けますが、わからない質問があります。夫に決めてもらわず、担当へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 問診回答を家族に委ねず確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can, but there's a question I don't understand. Rather than having my husband decide, I'd like to ask the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for clarification instead of leaving questionnaire answers to family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不明な欄を空けて、担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Leave the unclear field blank and discuss it with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。接種歴の質問が不明なので、その欄を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明な接種歴欄を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I don't understand the vaccination-history question, so I'll check that field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the unclear vaccination-history field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人一名の予約として確認します。問診の不明点は担当者へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll confirm it as a booking for you alone. Please tell the staff member your questionnaire questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道具は受け取りましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。畔にありますが、自分の班の分かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 畔の道具の所属不明を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. They're on the field ridge, but I don't know whether they're for my group.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the tools on the field ridge have an unknown group assignment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どんな目印がありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い札です。ただ、昨日は別の班も赤を使っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札色の重複を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: A red tag. However, another group used red yesterday too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the duplicate tag color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 色だけで決めず、担当者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't decide by color alone; check with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。持ち出す前に、札の文字と本数を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 文字と本数で持出し前確認を行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Before taking them, I'll tell them the lettering on the tag and the number of tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check before taking them using the lettering and quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な本数は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you confirmed how many tools are needed?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 班は三人ですが、三本必要とは限りません。作業の分担も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人数と必要道具数を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are three people in our group, but that doesn't necessarily mean we need three tools. I'll ask about the work assignments too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the number of people from the required number of tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が分担を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain the assignments.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。道具を余分に取らず、説明を聞いてから受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 分担説明後の必要数受取を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I won't take extra tools; I'll collect them after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to receive the required quantity after the work-assignment explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ここでお待ちください。担当と必要数を確認してからお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-NANTO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here. We'll give them to you after confirming the required quantity with the staff member.
